scores.category: Memorability (functional: onboarding, empty states, data moments, signature detail)
scores.evidence: Seven-step spotlight tutorial on real UI including a live field and its stepper pair (tour-1..7), the baseline band as signature detail on tiles, fields and Trends, the per-indicator ring with a verified one-time sweep, and the chamfered key family give a recognisable instrument-panel identity (today-dark-1440.png). Gaps: empty states (In transit, Inbox, Delivered, patches) are one line with an icon; Settings and Learn have no designed moment; the tile stagger after save was not shown.

All token pairs and every rendered text node pass in both themes; crew tabs are a roving tablist with names like 'Commander, Act now'; focus ring follows the cut on every control; primary flow is 6 keyboard actions at three widths; primary 56px, nav and steppers 48px, toggles 48px rows; Esc, arrows and focus trap work in the tour. No defect that blocks a task; the 13px labels are scored under typography.

uxWeighting: Product goal 'easy and quick for astronauts' is met on the core path: one status word and one blue key on Today, flagged tiles grouped first, a prefilled five-step check-in saved in 6 actions, 56px primary and 48px everything-else, a tutorial that shows where numbers go. Remaining costs are secondary: Alerts is a long page with every finding expanded, tablet width wastes its first screen on a body map band, the check-in cue card leaves half a screen empty on steps 1 and 3 while the camera link floats, and Learn is a flat reference wall.
